title: 광업ㆍ제조업조사 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Survey Reference Date and Survey Period)
(1) The Mining and Manufacturing Survey shall be conducted annually, and the survey reference date shall be December 31: Provided, That the Survey shall not be conducted in a year in which the Economic Census is conducted.
(2) The survey period shall be determined by the Administrator of the National Data Agency after comprehensively considering the timing at which financial statements of establishments become available and other relevant circumstances. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(3) Where deemed unavoidable, the Administrator of the National Data Agency may change the survey reference date under paragraph (1). <Amended on October 1, 2025>
